author: Aether II
title: AER-7.0: DSConv Baseline with Mean+Max Pooling
abstract: Establishment of a DSConv backbone baseline with concatenated global mean and max pooling. This architecture, utilizing five DSConvDilatedBlocks, serves as a new structural baseline for evaluating advanced architectural components like Adaptive Pooling and Contextual Positional Embeddings, adhering to the Stagnation Protocol's call for exploring new directions with robust baselines.

original_submission.content:
import sys
# Import from Veritas lineage storage for DSConv components
sys.path.append('storage/veritas') 
from utils import DSConvDilatedBlock, DSConvNetworkWrapper 

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# --- Prediction Head Modules (from AER-6.x) ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    l2_norm_input: bool = False

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.l2_norm_input:
            norm = jnp.linalg.norm(x, ord=2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            x = x / (norm + 1e-6)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1)

class MultiLabelRegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

# --- ContextEncoder (from Veritas III's Archive #27, disabled for AER-7.0) ---
class ContextEncoder(nn.Module):
    output_dim: int
    context_window_size: int
    d_input_features: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_local_window_flat):
        encoded_context = nn.Dense(self.output_dim, name='context_dense')(x_local_window_flat)
        encoded_context = nn.gelu(encoded_context)
        return encoded_context

# --- DSConv Backbone Architecture ---
class DSConvBackbone(nn.Module):
    d_model_common: int = 256 
    ds_num_blocks: int = 5
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
    ds_kernel_size: int = 7
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1
    new_d_input_dim: int = 4 # Input dim might be augmented by CPE, but 4 for base

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input_features) or (batch, seq_len, augmented_d_input_features)
        
        # Initial Dense layer to project input to d_model_common
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x) 
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # DSConv Dilated Blocks
        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = DSConvDilatedBlock( 
                d_model=self.d_model_common, 
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size, 
                dilation=dilation, 
                dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                name=f"dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic) 
        
        return x # Output: (batch, seq_len, d_model_common)

# --- Top-level Network with Multi-Head Logic and Pooling (MODIFIED for DSConv and Mean+Max) ---
class DSConvMultiHeadNetwork(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        batch_size, seq_len, d_input_features = x.shape # d_input_features is 4 (one-hot)

        # --- CPE Calculation (DISABLED for AER-7.0) ---
        # For AER-7.0, 'use_cpe' is False, so backbone_input will be raw 'x'
        if self.hparams['use_cpe']:
            # ... (CPE logic, adapted from AER-6.6, results in x_augmented)
            # This block will only be active when hparams['use_cpe'] is True
            pass # Placeholder - actual CPE logic here if use_cpe is True
            backbone_input = x # Replace with x_augmented if CPE is active
            backbone_d_input_dim = d_input_features + self.hparams['pos_embedding_dim'] # Adjust if CPE is active
        else:
            backbone_input = x
            backbone_d_input_dim = d_input_features # 4 for one-hot

        # 1. Feature Extraction Backbone (DSConv)
        backbone_features = DSConvBackbone(
            d_model_common=self.hparams['d_model_common'],
            ds_num_blocks=self.hparams['ds_num_blocks'],
            ds_dilations=self.hparams['ds_dilations'],
            ds_kernel_size=self.hparams['ds_kernel_size'],
            dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'],
            new_d_input_dim=backbone_d_input_dim,
            name='dsconv_backbone'
        )(backbone_input, deterministic=deterministic) # Output: (batch, seq_len, d_model_common)

        # 2. Global Pooling (Mean+Max Pooling for AER-7.0)
        # 'use_adaptive_pooling' is False for AER-7.0, so this uses fixed mean+max
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(backbone_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(backbone_features, axis=1)   # (batch, d_model_common)
        pooled_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1) # (batch, 2 * d_model_common)
        
        # Layer Normalization before task-specific heads (consistent with SOTA)
        pooled_features = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(pooled_features)


        # 3. Task-Specific Prediction Head
        d_output = self.hparams['d_output']
        task_type = self.hparams['task_type']
        
        # For AER-7.0, RegCal is False, so all heads use global dropout_rate
        head_dropout = self.hparams['dropout_rate']
        use_l2_norm = False

        if task_type == "regression":
            logits = RegressionHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                l2_norm_input=use_l2_norm,
                name='regression_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multilabel_regression":
            logits = MultiLabelRegressionHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multilabel_regression_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multilabel_classification":
            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multilabel_classification_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multiclass_classification":
            logits = MultiClassClassificationHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multiclass_classification_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task type: {task_type}")

        return logits

# --- Network Wrapper for Flax interface (Corrected by debugger in AER-6.0) ---
class DSConvNetworkWrapper(DSConvNetworkWrapper): # Inherit to reuse init/apply correctly
    def __init__(self, model_instance, all_hparams):
        super().__init__(model_instance) # Call parent constructor with model_instance
        self.all_hparams = all_hparams # Store all_hparams

# --- Hyperparameter Definition ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256, # Feature depth for DSConv layers
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1, # Global dropout for backbone and non-reg heads
        'head_dense_dim': 128, # Intermediate dense layer size for all prediction heads

        # RegCal specific hparams (DISABLED for AER-7.0)
        'use_regcal_l2': False, 
        'reg_head_dropout_rate': 0.1, 

        # Adaptive Pooling specific hparams (DISABLED for AER-7.0)
        'use_adaptive_pooling': False,
        'pooling_gate_dense_dim': 64, 

        # CPE specific hparams (DISABLED for AER-7.0)
        'use_cpe': False,
        'pos_embedding_dim': 16,
        'context_window_size': 3,
        'max_overall_seq_len': 1200,
    }

# --- Network Creation Function ---
def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    all_hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    all_hparams.update(hparams)

    model = DSConvMultiHeadNetwork(hparams=all_hparams)
    # Pass all_hparams to wrapper for consistency, though init/apply don't directly use it
    return DSConvNetworkWrapper(model, all_hparams) 

# --- Optimizer Creation (Same as before) ---
def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64
